mintAuthority.summary: Frankencoin has no owner; minting is performed by minter plugins and positions that pass the protocol's veto-governed minter registry.

controls.label: Frankencoin minter registry
controls.capDescription: Approved minters and their registered positions can mint; new minters are subject to the application period and qualified pool-share holder veto.
controls.evidence: Source review showed suggestMinter, denyMinter, registerPosition, mintWithReserve, and mint guarded by minterOnly; no owner() was present. Contract comments describe arbitrary minting plugins accepted unless qualified pool-share holders veto.

sources.label: Frankencoin governance documentation (veto process, 2% qualified-voter threshold, immutable contracts)

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-17 against the pinned source and on-chain state: Frankencoin has no owner; minting runs through minter plugins and their registered positions. Anyone can propose a minter via suggestMinter (MIN_FEE 1000 ZCHF; on-chain MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD 1209600 seconds = 14 days at block 25551030), and qualified pool-share holders (more than 2% of holding-period-weighted votes per the governance documentation; enforced by Equity.checkQualified) can veto during the application period via denyMinter. The deployed token contract is not a proxy and its own NatSpec states it is not upgradable, so mint logic cannot change; the governed surface is limited to accepting or vetoing new minting plugins. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable code and a 14-day broad-holder veto govern new minters, issuance is on-chain collateralized, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
